Not bashing anyone that put in the time to make what we have happen, but it did leave me with a sense of “this is it?”. Was really expecting more fanfare and a more clearly celebratory venue. This looks more like random assets cobbled together in the middle of nowhere.

You’d also think that maybe you’d see photos of employees celebrating the occasion together at work, wouldn’t you..? 20 years isn’t something a lot of games can claim, and it’s a well established IP that many of us grew up with. I feel like in the past, this would have been something you’d see customers and employees alike having fun with and being social over.

I guess in short, it doesn’t feel like this event really captures any kind of excitement, it just feels like another project someone had to do. That said, I do still want the DK mog.
